replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thank you for your interest in collaborating with *ArchEyes
<https://archeyes.com/>*.

We help brands reach architects, designers, engineers, and industry
decision-makers through relevant editorial content and targeted advertising.
Here’s an overview of our collaboration options:

   1. *Sponsored / Guest article: $395 - *You provide the content; we
   review and publish it.
   Includes permanent publication, homepage placement at launch, inclusion
   in our weekly newsletter (14,100+ subscribers), two external links, and
   unlimited internal links.
   2. *Article written by our editors: $495 - *Our team develops the
   article from your brief, with all the benefits above.
   3. *Link Integration into an existing article: $250 -* We add a relevant
   branded paragraph and link to an existing article.
   4. *Sidebar banner: $295/month - *A vertical banner displayed across all
   posts and approximately 80% of site pages.
   5. *Custom brand integration: $350/month - *A dedicated brand page and
   ongoing editorial visibility, with benefits detailed in our media kit.
   6. *Instagram post: $250/post - *A sponsored post featuring your brand.
   7. *Newsletter feature: $85 -* A standalone placement in our weekly
   newsletter reaching 14,100+ subscribers.

Our *media kit and sponsored content guidelines
<https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MHNNbneSdSKQesNXM_HFqBiMcsk0BWSC?usp=drive_link>
*provide
full readership details and publication requirements.
Rates for the placements above are fixed. Sponsored articles already
include newsletter inclusion.
You can see a recent example here:
https://archeyes.com/planning-an-open-concept-renovation-removing-walls-load-bearing-checks-and-permits/

Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or need
further assistance.
We look forward to working with you.

 Best regards,
 Roberto Ortiz de Landazuri

On Sat, Oct 24, 2026 at 6:26 PM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi ArchEyes team,
>
> (Writing to the ArchEyes newsroom directly — this is meant for
> whichever desk is closest to the topic below. Feel free to forward as
> appropriate.)
>
> Really enjoyed your profile of Ando's Row House — the way you read the
> Azuma House's discipline of light and shadow, and how a minimalist
> concrete shell reshapes everyday urban living, was beautifully done.
>
> A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European
> construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los
> Angeles, designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.
>
> One thought your piece sparked: Ando's lesson, that concrete can be
> both structural and deeply livable, is exactly what LA is now
> rediscovering. That meeting of durability and light feels like the
> real story.
>
> Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are
> doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>
